questions.1.2: Was the allocation sequence concealed until participants were enrolled and assigned to interventions?
questions.1.3: Did baseline differences between intervention groups suggest a problem with the randomization process?

questions.2.1: Were participants aware of their assigned intervention during the trial?
questions.2.2: Were carers and people delivering the interventions aware of participants' assigned intervention during the trial?
questions.2.3: Were there deviations from the intended intervention that arose because of the trial context?
questions.2.4: Were these deviations likely to have affected the outcome?
questions.2.5: Were these deviations from intended intervention balanced between groups?
questions.2.6: Was an appropriate analysis used to estimate the effect of assignment to intervention?
questions.2.7: Was there potential for a substantial impact on the result of the failure to analyse participants in the group to which they were randomized?

questions.3.1: Were data for this outcome available for all, or nearly all, participants randomized?
questions.3.2: Is there evidence that the result was not biased by missing outcome data?
questions.3.3: Could missingness in the outcome depend on its true value?
questions.3.4: Is it likely that missingness in the outcome depended on its true value?

questions.4.1: Was the method of measuring the outcome inappropriate?
questions.4.2: Could measurement or ascertainment of the outcome have differed between intervention groups?
questions.4.3: Were outcome assessors aware of the intervention received by participants?
questions.4.4: Could assessment of the outcome have been influenced by knowledge of intervention received?
questions.4.5: Is it likely that assessment of the outcome was influenced by knowledge of intervention received?

questions.5.1: Were the data that produced this result analysed in accordance with a pre-specified analysis plan finalized before unblinded outcome data were available?
questions.5.2: Was the numerical result likely selected from multiple eligible outcome measurements on the basis of the results?
questions.5.3: Was the numerical result likely selected from multiple eligible analyses on the basis of the results?
